description: Comparison tolerances for contracts/reference fixtures. Values are derived from the Phase 1 measurements of both implementations (see CHANGELOG), with headroom.

positions_mean_equinox_arcsec.note: Moon includes pre-1972 Delta-T handling differences (1950 epoch). Mean-equinox longitude = Horizons true-equinox longitude - nutation_longitude_deg. Bodies each implementation must meet these for: capabilities.json ephemeris_grade_bodies (within ephemeris_grade_coverage_utc).

moon_phase_note: USNO rounds phase times to the minute (|dt| <= 30 s); Moon-Sun elongation changes ~0.51 arcsec/s.
